dimension_definitions.definition: The module materially helps the founder/operator loop or core agent capability in current tracked repo behavior.
Blocked authority, non-goals, and safety boundaries are explicit in source, tests, docs, or verifier evidence.
Focused tests cover normal behavior, denial behavior, edge cases, and regression-prone safety boundaries.
The module is visible in Control Center or operator-facing docs/read models rather than hidden implementation only.
The module has CLI or repo-local script inspection parity for operator-relevant behavior.
Repo-owned evidence refs, verifiers, manifests, docs, and tests prove current truth without raw/private payloads.
The module is understandable and usable by an operator through clear state, receipts, reasons, next actions, or blocked states.
Tracked implementation goes beyond declarations and contracts into bounded, tested local behavior when allowed.

queued_prompt_execution_policy.policy: Every queued follow-up task from this review must use at least one independent subagent before final hardening. Implementation subagents must own disjoint write scopes; read-only subagents must report evidence, safety, and product-language findings. The main agent remains responsible for integration, verification, and final truth.
